title: Beztack Sync policy
description: Schema-versioned Sync policy for Beztack template sync. Declares Ownership strategy rules, Sync seams, the Environment contract path, and Template parameter file location. A valid Sync policy must validate overlaps and shadowing before apply per ADR-0006.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Engines must refuse unknown values.

templateId.description: Identifier of the Template source this policy belongs to.

file.description: Path to the persisted Template parameter file in a Derived project.
Path to the Environment contract file (Template-owned).

note.description: Ownership note. Does not change sync behavior.

ownership.description: Ordered Ownership rules. First match wins for non-overlapping cases. Engines must detect overlaps and shadowing across rules before apply.

path.description: Glob relative to the Derived project root.

note.description: Human-readable Ownership note. Records intent without changing merge behavior.

seams.description: Sync seams. Mixed ownership should be resolved through Sync seams where practical; zone markers remain an escape hatch.

marker.description: Marker convention used at the seam, if any.

minimumVersion.description: Minimum Sync engine version compatible with this policy.
